no-restricted-syntax.message: Avoid calling .select() with no arguments; specify explicit columns or shared selectors from @/lib/db/selects.
Avoid .select('*'); specify explicit columns to prevent Supabase egress bloat.
Avoid unbounded .findMany() calls; add take/skip pagination and explicit select.
Always bound Prisma .findMany() with 'take' (and explicit 'select') or use shared helpers from @/lib/db/queries.
